name: gateway-purpose-and-positioning
title: Dynamics Gateway P5-P8 roadmap and positioning
description: Own the P5-P8 Dynamics Gateway roadmap. P3-P7.3 are archived baseline evidence; P7.4 is active and gate-disabled pending legacy/Gateway capacity proof, while P7.2 recurring payment-return work remains local-only. P7.5 awaits zero ToolUtility/CRM SDK product references, and P8 follows only after immutable P7.5 handoff and externally authorized deployment readiness.
currentBaseline: 2026-08-14: P3-P6 and P7.0/P7.3 are archived baseline; Official Worker live compatibility remains evidence-pending without blocking Data8-first local reads. Historical P7.2 Slice C is permanently closed after write-not-committed no-go and exact cleanup. The QR weekly-attendance family (ORG-CALL-00063) is a local design no-go because browser/route values reach process-wide InMemoryContext before a provable request-local server authorization boundary, and its one call mixes multiple mutation/notification effects; it did not perform CE operations and does not block independent P7 families. ORG-CALL-00047 is an independent source-only local design no-go because its legacy mutable list workflow has no request-local server-derived list authorization, static and dynamic list semantics differ, and dynamic list uses CRM-stored FetchXML; no static-only partial Gateway migration, CE or consumer work occurred. ORG-CALL-00031/00032 are an independent source-only local design no-go: the MemberInfo tree derives access from Session/InMemoryContext and its Shepherd scope may load shared ListManager data with saved credentials before a request-local authorization boundary. ORG-CALL-00033 is a related but separately recorded source-only local design no-go: its relation-goal callers derive contact IDs through that same untrusted authorization chain, while the connection expansion has no operation-specific response budgets and converts faults/partial state to empty display text. Church-only partial migration is forbidden. These no-go findings do not block unrelated P7 families. ORG-CALL-00014, 00065, and 00026 have completed only their own local registry/Data8 fixed-query/closed-response/ProductClient or disabled-boundary evidence and remain not-migrated for consumer/CE/host/traffic. P7.4 remains disabled-by-default local migration. P7.5 prerequisite report remains no-go with temporary-legacy rows and zero-reference/CE/host/parity/soak/drain/rollback gaps.
scope: P5-P8 roadmap parent; P7.2 financial-write boundary and P7.4 disabled local consumer children own implementation while P7.5/P8 retain prerequisite gates.
creator: codex
nextAction: After archiving the ORG-CALL-00033 relation-goal authorization/response-boundary local no-go child, select the next independently verifiable local P7 capability from the authoritative matrix. It must have a bounded DTO-only contract, request-local server-derived authorization, no shared mutable bridge, no stored CRM query execution, unbounded response expansion or unresolved write adjacency, task-owned tests and scope-only commit/archive. Do not cut over a consumer, enable gates, issue CE requests, retry historical Slice C, start P7.5 removal or create P8 until their immutable handoff gates are green.
notes: Canonical route: P5 archived -> P6 Router/Pool/Lease local completion with Official Worker live compatibility evidence-pending -> P7.0-P7.5 ChurchReport migration -> ToolUtility removal -> independently authorized P8.0-P8.4 CentralGateway deployment. Historical P7.2 Slice C remains permanently closed after write-not-committed no-go and exact cleanup. QR attendance ORG-CALL-00063 is an isolated local design no-go: browser/route data reaches shared InMemoryContext before server authorization and one QR call mixes multiple writer effects; no CE action occurred, and the family must first receive a request-local authorization-boundary child. ORG-CALL-00047 is an isolated source-only local design no-go: existing mutable list workflow lacks request-local server-derived list authorization and dynamic lists execute CRM-stored FetchXML, so static-only partial migration, raw query/object bridges, CE and consumer cutover are forbidden until a dedicated authorization/template child proves the stated recovery conditions. ORG-CALL-00031/00032 are an isolated source-only local design no-go: MemberInfo tree access comes from Session/InMemoryContext, and Shepherd list scope may invoke a saved-credential ListManager loader before any immutable request-local authorization boundary. ORG-CALL-00033 is a separate source-only local design no-go: all existing relation-goal callers derive contact IDs through that same access chain; moreover its connection query has no operation-specific page/row/text/byte limits and normalizes faults/partial state to empty display text. A Church-only partial migration is forbidden; a separate server-derived MemberInfo scope child is required before descriptor/membership/relation-goal work can resume. These no-go findings do not block unrelated P7 families. ORG-CALL-00041 has local registry/Data8/ProductClient evidence only; it is not consumer, CE or cutover evidence. ORG-CALL-00014, ORG-CALL-00065, and ORG-CALL-00026 have only their own local typed-read/disabled-boundary evidence and remain consumer/CE/host pending. P7.4 local-only disabled candidates remain the active migration route. P7.5 prerequisite evidence remains deterministic no-go: temporary-legacy matrix rows and legacy source/project/settings plus CE/host/parity/soak/drain/rollback gaps remain. P7.5 removal and P8 remain gated.
